# Gelabber v0.12.0

Voice, screen share and push notifications, plus a server that stays fast
under load. **The upgrade runs three database migrations (0042 to 0044):
take a backup first, because going back to v0.11.0 is only possible by
restoring it.** `.env` needs no edit.

## Changes

**Voice and screen share**

- Input sensitivity gate for the microphone (Settings → Audio →
  "Eingabeempfindlichkeit": automatic, manual or off), web and desktop.
  #651 (GEL-27)
- "Text scharf halten" for a Live: lowers the frame rate before the
  resolution, off by default. #645 (GEL-26)
- Viewers on a weak download keep a sharp Live, with a "Bildqualität" menu
  per viewer. #667 (GEL-32)

**Push notifications** (GEL-17)

- Server channels push by each member's notification level, not only
  mentions; mentions wake a sleeping phone. #622
- Declarative push messages for Safari (iOS 18.4, macOS 15.5) and renewed
  subscriptions. #624
- One push up to 48 hours before a session ends. #625
- A push when someone goes live, and an opt-in "Push, wenn ein Anruf
  beginnt" per server. #627, #628, #638

**Chat, members and layout**

- Writing into a DM whose peer blocks you no longer shows "403 dm_closed";
  the message is kept for its sender only. #623 (GEL-19)
- The member list is virtualized and shows members who join or leave
  live. #620, #631, #629, #643 (GEL-14, GEL-20, GEL-22)
- The channel list folds away and both sidebars resize by dragging, web
  and desktop. #668 (GEL-34)
- The composer's rejected-file note goes away again. #648 (GEL-8)
- Desktop: the "System" theme takes over Omarchy, KDE and GNOME accent
  colors and follows them live. #641 (GEL-9)
- New public landing page. #640

**Server**

- WebSocket checks get their own database pool and events are shared
  between sockets, so delivery keeps up under load. #635 (GEL-12, GEL-13)
- API and media gateway give memory back to the system after load peaks.
  #630 (GEL-15)

**CI and repository**

- Load test scripts and memory sampler #618 (GEL-16); chat workflows and
  fault scenarios back in Extended E2E #652, #655, #657 (GEL-30, GEL-31,
  GEL-33); parity for Settings → Audio #642 (GEL-18); planning in Linear
  #634, #637 (GEL-23, GEL-24).

## Upgrade notes

- **Back up first** (`deploy/backup.sh`, see `deploy/README.md` "Backup"),
  or pause Watchtower before this release is published.
- **Three migrations, none reversible without the backup:**
  `0042_sender_only_messages` (`messages.sender_only`,
  `message_reactions.sender_only`), `0043_push_last_call`
  (`push_subscriptions.warned_at`), `0044_voice_push`
  (`notification_settings.voice`).
- **New optional variable** `API_DB_GATEWAY_CONNECTIONS` (default 10). The
  API now holds up to 30 Postgres connections by default; keep
  `API_DB_MAX_CONNECTIONS` and it together well below Postgres'
  `max_connections` (100 in the bundled Postgres).
- The image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to
  `v0.12.0`. **Rollback:** only by restoring the backup together with the
  v0.11.0 image set.
- **Order:** server first, then clients. Older clients keep working; they
  lack the new switches, and an older desktop app leaves the call push as
  set. Against an older gateway, new clients play a Live as before.
- **Desktop:** Windows offers the update itself; Arch: `pacman -Syu`.

All changes: [v0.11.0...v0.12.0](https://github.com/Till-und-Scholler-AI-slop/Gelabber/compare/v0.11.0...v0.12.0)
